question: Where can I find a list of new apartment developments in Houston?
answer:
## Where to find Houston apartment development news

**Local news trackers (free, updated regularly)**
- **Houston Chronicle's Residential Development Tracker** — a running list of projects in various stages (proposed, under construction, completed) across the metro. Best single free source for a curated overview.
- **Houston Business Journal** and **Houston.org** (Greater Houston Partnership) also publish periodic roundups of new residential/mixed-use projects.
- **Houston Opportunity Zones Active Projects** page (houstontx.gov) if you care about projects tied to Opportunity Zone incentives.

**Industry pipeline reports (free/semi-free, more data-driven)**
- **MMG Real Estate Advisors** publishes quarterly Houston multifamily pipeline reports with unit counts and submarket breakdowns.
- **Yardi Matrix** publishes a Houston multifamily market report blog series with construction-pipeline stats (units underway, starts, completions) — good for macro trend numbers even without a paid subscription.

**Paid/professional data platforms (most granular, project-by-project)**
- **CoStar** — the industry-standard commercial real estate database; tracks individual multifamily projects by address, developer, unit count, and delivery date. Typically requires a subscription or brokerage access.
- **RealPage Analytics** and **Yardi Matrix** (full platform, not just the blog) — similar paid tools used by developers, lenders, and brokers to see the full pipeline (planning, under construction, lease-up, stabilized).

**Practical tip:** if you want a specific submarket (e.g., Inner Loop, Katy, The Woodlands, EaDo), a local commercial broker (Marcus & Millichap, JLL, Colliers Houston offices) can usually pull a CoStar-based pipeline report for that area faster than piecing it together from news sources.

Sources:
- [Track residential developments coming to the Houston area in 2026 and beyond](https://www.houstonchronicle.com/projects/real-estate/houston-residential-development-tracker/)
- [16 exciting developments coming to Houston in 2026 and beyond](https://www.houstonchronicle.com/business/real-estate/article/retail-mixed-use-new-development-houston-21118226.php)
- [New Residential Developments Rising in Houston | Houston.org](https://houston.org/news/new-residential-developments-rising-houston/)

- [Opportunity Zones Active Projects](https://www.houstontx.gov/opportunityzones/activeprojects.html)
- [Houston Apartment Data - Yardi Matrix Blog](https://www.yardimatrix.com/blog/houston-apartment-data/)
- [Houston Multifamily Market Report | Yardi Matrix Blog](https://www.yardimatrix.com/blog/houston-multifamily-market-report/)
